## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 29, 2026 - Sep 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Janice Lehman_, Sep 29, 2026, 1/5: "I paid $79 for a years subscription and was happily using the app for 3 weeks. then it stopped. Everything was lost and the app wants me to resign up. I canceled the subscription and it said I can use the app until the current subscription expires which is next September. however I can't use it because it has stopped. I looked for contact information so I could talk to someone to get this resolved bit found none. my money is wasted since I can't even use the app anyone without resigning up"
            2. _Amanda Gauvin_, Sep 30, 2026, 3/5: "years ago I used this app when everything was free. just redownloaded. I'm not paying for premium to use the barcode scanner. that's annoying"
            3. _Jessica Eckroth_, Sep 29, 2026, 3/5: "too much behind paywall"
<!--/ir-theme-->
